verdicts.says: 20 of 20 real files passed verify-before-parse; fidelity csv 100.0%, docx 100.0%, eml 100.0%, ics 100.0%, image 100.0%, pdf 99.1%, vcf 100.0%, xlsx 100.0%, zip 100.0% (the worst PDF 95.5%).
284 hostile files: 116 refused at verify-before-parse, 52 quarantined by the sandbox, 116 admitted; the core process loaded 0 reader modules; 188 parses, every one in a sandbox.

In the sandbox: network refused, write refused, readOutside refused, childProcess refused, worker refused; an endless loop was killed at the time cap; a memory hog died at the 64 MB cap; 20 of 20 originals kept read-only.
